Diff is exactly the 8 touch-listed files, 814 insertions, 0 deletions; per-class caps respected (hexcell-core 129/280, tests 272/420, configuracion.rs 41/130); no forbidden path touched.

Payload verified to serve HEX-077-b: ValorDeDato::Instante (ban expiry), ValorDeDato::Conversacion(IdConversacion) (affected contact), ValorDeDato::Componente(Nucleo|Sidecar) (which container looped) all present and round-trip intact through the fake sink test.

Token-leak check done by hand, not just by the grep guard: read hyper-util 0.1.20's Client::Error (client.rs) -- its Display/Debug carry only an ErrorKind enum (Canceled/ChannelClosed/Connect/...) plus source, never the request URI, so a connect/transport failure cannot leak the token embedded in the sendMessage URL. ConfiguracionDeTelegram and NotificadorTelegram both hand-redact the token field in their Debug impls, and a test explicitly asserts format!("{error:?}") excludes the token on a 401.

Guard audit, per explicit instruction to hunt vacuous guards: none found. The two Cargo-manifest/lockfile guards (cargo tree line count; git diff --quiet) both diff against main...HEAD, not the working tree, so they stay live post-commit -- they do not reproduce the known dead-guard shape (grep over an empty working-tree diff) recorded in project memory. The 6 notificaciones.rs tests and 3 configuracion.rs cases each assert a value that changes with the code path exercised (state transitions None->error->Some, matches! on the selector enum, exact string/byte content), none is a constant-discriminant or lossy-format-collapse assertion.

Scope check confirmed both ways: the diff does not implement any of the eight alert conditions, per-cell metrics, or the dead-man's switch (HEX-077-b/c/d untouched), and it deliberately does NOT wire SumideroDeCelula into crates/hexcell/src/main.rs nor add HEXCELL_TELEGRAM_* to deploy/cell.compose.yml or deploy/celula.env.ejemplo -- correct per this child's contract, not an omission.
